description: Retrieve the owned CAD reconstruction, editable parameter inventory with verified source-component dependencies and input_groups for dimensions and advanced detail controls, coverage/fidelity, immutable revision SHA and document/preview/STEP artifact identities. Set reconstruction_id to reconstruction_artifact_id from the completed operation, not its display surface artifact_id. Use reconstruction_sha256 for edits. Face recognition alone does not qualify arbitrary feature edits. The full measured source-face inventory is retained in its report artifact; use artifact downloads only when the user requests an export.
name: get_cad_reconstruction
title: Get CAD reconstruction
